claims.object_text: located presynaptically in the perforant path, Schaffer collaterals, mossy fibers, and commissural/associational pathways
claims.quote: SNAP-25, a neuronal specific protein, is located presynaptically in the perforant path, Schaffer collaterals, mossy fibers, and commissural/associational pathways.

claims.object_text: loss of SNAP-25 immunoreactivity at the site of the axonal projections of the lesioned neurons
claims.quote: Selective destruction of CA3 pyramidal neurons, dentate gyrus granule cells, and entorhinal cortical neurons resulted in a loss of SNAP-25 immunoreactivity at the site of the axonal projections of the lesioned neurons.

claims.object_text: SNAP-25 immunoreactivity maintained in projections to lesioned region and enhanced in adjacent deafferented areas
claims.quote: SNAP-25 immunoreactivity was maintained in projections to the lesioned region, and enhanced in areas adjacent to those deafferented by the lesions.

claims.object_text: increased expression of SNAP-25 mRNA in denervated regions and in neurons participating in sprouting
claims.quote: Expression of SNAP 25 mRNA was increased in denervated regions, and in neurons which would be expected to participate in the sprouting response.
